records.title: Rethinking Software Engineering in the Foundation Model Era: A Curated Catalogue of Challenges in the Development of Trustworthy FMware
records.reason: This is a catalog of trustworthy foundation-model software-engineering challenges; its object is development practice rather than model inference optimization.

records.title: HASP: Hierarchical Asynchronous Parallelism for Multi-NN Tasks
records.reason: 一次出版社ページ https://doi.org/10.1109/TC.2023.3329937 を開いたが、読める要旨/本文を取得できず、入力要旨だけで対象外とは判定しない。一次証拠を照合できないためborderline。

records.title: A Temporal-Spectral Fusion Transformer with Subject-specific Adapter for Enhancing RSVP-BCI Decoding
records.reason: The temporal-spectral Transformer with subject-specific adapters addresses RSVP-BCI EEG decoding. Input, task and experiments are EEG classification, not LLM inference or language-model serving.

records.title: MCAIMem: A Mixed SRAM and eDRAM Cell for Area and Energy-Efficient On-Chip AI Memory
records.reason: MCAIMem designs mixed SRAM/eDRAM memory cells and reports area/energy tradeoffs for on-chip AI, but does not evaluate LLM inference or KV/model memory. Transfer to the target lineage is unestablished.

records.title: LS-Guard: Adaptive Safety Guardrails Tailored to Individual LLMs
records.reason: LS-Guard studies individualized LLM safety guardrails; the primary abstract does not target inference compute, memory, latency, or serving.
